expected_memories.content_gist: The Reuter Electrical Backbone project transforms the electrical system at the Reuter site and is being implemented through EU-wide tenders in 9 lots
Lot 4c covers the planning, delivery, installation, commissioning and product training of two 400/110 kV grid transformers with ONAN/ONAF cooling systems
The Lot 4c grid transformers are rated 300 MVA, with 360 MVA in the second rating, a voltage ratio of 400/110 kV with plus or minus 13 steps of 1.23 percent, and an impedance of 16 percent in YNyn0
The Lot 4c transformers connect the REB substation to the 380 kV network of 50Hertz at the Reuter West combined heat and power plant in Berlin
Lot 4c includes two ETOS or equivalent transformer monitoring systems connected to the station control system under IEC 61850
The secondary technology components, protection and control cabinets, are not included in the scope of delivery of Lot 4c
Lot 4d covers two 110/22.5 kV distribution transformers with cooling systems for connecting an electric hot water generator, a 120 MW electrode boiler system

The Lot 4d distribution transformers are rated 125 MVA, with 150 MVA in the second rating, a voltage ratio of 110/22 kV with plus or minus 12 steps of 1.31 percent, and an impedance of 12.5 percent in Yyn10 plus d
The 110 kV connection on the Lot 4d transformers must be made using 110 kV cables, and the 22.5 kV side must be planned for an air-insulated 24 kV high-current busbar system
The 110 kV cable and the 22.5 kV busbar connections are not part of the scope of work for Lot 4d and are provided by the customer
